title: Implementations
description:
Implementation entries of the levels 0 to 2: `simd_ext/<isa>/<isa>_native_implems.json` (Level 0), `simd_ext/<isa>/<isa>_emu_implems.json` (Level 1) and, for every ISA, `helpers_headers/generic_emu_implems.json`, `generic_emu_implems_mask.json` (masked variants) and `generic_emu_implems_lmulh.json` (horizontal functions with LMUL > 1) (Level 2). Each function maps to a list of candidate entries. For each datatype, mask variant and preprocessor condition, the [candidate resolver](../../internals/code_generation.md) keeps the lowest level whose dependencies are available.

Checked when the file is loaded: the functions and the datatypes exist in the interfaces and in the ISA descriptor, and every `template` / `template_ref` resolves. The `levels`, `dead-code` and `duplicates` audits check the placement and the overlaps of the entries.

anyOf.description: Function → entries (the format of all the current files).

item.description: A candidate implementation of a function.

instr_name.description: String passed to the template as `instr_name`, usually the name of the intrinsic without prefix and suffix (`add`, `recpeq`). Omitted: the function name in the generic files, an empty string in the ISA files.

datatypes.description: Alias of `DATATYPES_MAP` or explicit list of the datatypes (pairs for the conversions) of the entry.

template.description: Name of a template of the matching `*_templates.json` file of the ISA, or an inline template ([Templates](templates.md)). One of `template` and `template_ref` is required.

template_ref.description: Reference to a generic template, with its prefix: `tpl_generic_emu.<name>`, `tpl_mask_generic_emu.<name>` or `tpl_horiz_lmul_generic_emu.<name>`.

if.description: Preprocessor condition of the entry. The entry is emitted under `#if <condition>`; the rest of the condition space goes to the next candidates.

skip_audit_level.description: `true` disables the `levels` audit for this entry.

skip_audit_level_reason.description: Why the `levels` audit is disabled (requires `skip_audit_level: true`).

version.description: `mask`, `maskz` or `masks`: the entry implements this mask variant (without it, the unmasked function). `horiz_lmul`: the entry implements a horizontal function with LMUL > 1.

type.description: Set by the generator when the files are loaded (`emulated` for the emulation files): leave it out.

dependencies.description: Computed by the generator from the MIPP calls of the template: leave it out.

preferred_simd_ext.description: ISA or list of ISAs. Among the candidates of the same level, the entry is tried first on these ISAs and last on the others.

simd_size.description: Register size or list of sizes, in bits after LMUL, for which the entry applies (e.g. `128`).

embedded_template.description: Inline template, same fields as in a templates file ([Templates](templates.md)).
